notes.title: Chat Ragdoll Racing Patch Notes 0.3
notes.content:
* change: improvements on western level to help with characters getting stuck
* bugfix: leaderboard scroll is now more sensitivite
* bugfix: camera no longer glitches out when switching from manual to automatic
* bugfix: ui selection now resets properly in menus
* change: camera movementspeed now gradually builds up instead of snapping, when sprinting
* change: camera mode can now be toggled with m
* change: manual camera now automatically looks at where player is pointing at, legacy option is still available in settings

* change: automatic camera is no longer locked on its x axis
* change: base camera speed is increased by 2x

notes.title: Chat Ragdoll Racing Patch Notes 0.2
notes.content:
- Bugfix: Horse racing gamemode was not automatically starting.
- Bugfix: UI scaling with ultrawide monitors.
- Bugfix: resume button missing on pause menu.
- Bugfix: anvil was spawning above the plane
- Bugfix: train is no longer flying at the end
- Bugfix: firetruck not spawning through obstacle command
- Bugfix: cannon projectile is no longer leaking after the cannon has been destroyed
- Bugfix: fix camera jitter when following a target

- Improvement: display timer no longer allocates memory every frame
- Improvement: projectiles, objects and particles reuse memory with object pooling
- Improvement: Manual camera toggle is now in the top right corner of the screen at all times

- Feature: Camera can now be controlled with mouse inputs.
- Feature: Character Mouse dragging now requires user to hold left control
- Feature: sideways movement is now possible

- Change: change pig skin physics material to make it slide little bit slower.
- Change: Increase cooldown of fan and machine gun to reduce chances of characters getting stuck for a long time
- Change: Add new node into western mape
